issues.description: Tiny extraction unconditionally loads external story data, so the advertised CPU demo fails in the checked-out repo.
Story loading requires data/stories/manifest.json and per-emotion text files, but the repository contains an empty data/stories directory.
The integration test is not reproducible from the repo because its required fixture data is missing.
Default configuration points at data/stories even though no usable story corpus is present.
Validation trusts the caller's backend config instead of checking it matches the vector manifest, allowing invalid cross-model or cross-seed comparisons.
Preference steering also rebuilds the backend from current config without validating compatibility with the saved vectors.
Tiny preference steering ignores the saved steering vector and layer, so tiny steering results do not actually validate vector artifacts.
HF preference scoring computes a single good-minus-bad continuation score rather than true pairwise activity preference logits as documented.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component when threshold is 0, even though zero explained variance should remove no components.
HuggingFace model and tokenizer are loaded without a pinned revision, making extraction results drift as upstream model files change.
HF activation capture has no max-length, truncation, or batching controls, creating avoidable OOM risk on long stories.
CLI defaults assume config.yaml and data paths exist in the current working directory, so installed console scripts are fragile outside the repo root.
Packaging includes only the emovec package and omits config/data needed by the documented CLI workflow.
Context validation does not guard against missing scenario coverage, which can cause empty-stack errors or meaningless diagonal/off-diagonal summaries.
steering.min_reported_emotions is configured but not read; steer_prefs hard-codes four emotions instead.
Documented make demo and equivalent tiny commands do not work from a clean checkout because extraction cannot find story data.
